name: OverlayManager
purpose: Manage keyed authored overlay instances, typed results and completed exits without replacing overlay behavior.
useWhen: Several application locations open or update an overlay, or await its result.
composition: Create one manager with createOverlay. Mount its Viewport below application providers before opening. Spread injected lifecycle props onto the overlay root.

rules.statement: Keep open, onOpenChange and onExitComplete manager-owned. Forward all three to the overlay root; do not guess animation duration.
Use one Viewport per manager. Application contexts come from Viewport; do not mutate a shared server manager across requests.

commonMistakes.mistake: Awaiting close to obtain the user answer.
commonMistakes.correction: Await open for the typed result; close and waitForExit await exit completion. Removal settles pending work.

commonMistakes.mistake: Waiting for an animation from an instance that never committed open, or treating snapshot reads as reactive hooks.
commonMistakes.correction: Precommit closure is removed automatically; committed instances still require the authored exit callback. Use application state for reactive activity displays.

validation: Test result versus exit timing, early close, suspended content, layout-effect closure, updates, reopen during exit, removal, host disposal, nested focus and provider context.
